scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build:main && vite build
scripts.build:main: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist-electron', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && node scripts/package-lode-assets.mjs && node scripts/package-runtime-assets.mjs
scripts.test:workbench-dom: pnpm run build:main && node scripts/workbench-protected-store-smoke.mjs && electron scripts/workbench-dom-smoke.mjs && node scripts/workbench-dom-smoke-exit-test.mjs
scripts.smoke: pnpm run build && node scripts/smoke.mjs && node scripts/smoke-skill-workbench.mjs
scripts.smoke:packaged:runtime: WEBENVOY_REQUIRE_PACKAGED_RUNTIME=1 pnpm run build && node scripts/smoke-packaged-runtime.mjs
